title: I / you / he / she
note: The core cast of any conversation.

because.title: Here's the twist
because.explain: In Spanish the verb ending tells you who — so they often skip the pronoun. "Como" already means "I eat."
because.key: They only say "yo" for emphasis — like "*I* did it."
because.fun: "Yo quiero Taco Bell" — that yo is extra emphasis.
because.src: Called a pro-drop language. Verbs carry so much info pronouns are optional.
